definition: A window of time that is opportune for a recall. Recalls incur a high [tempo](/term/tempo) cost. A recalling [player](/term/player) is inactionable for a recall’s 8-second channel time, then off the map from any standing resources or potential [plays](/term/play) until they leave base. An optimal recall timing aims to minimize tempo costs by finding a period of time where minimal enemy minions die and action on the map is low.
